questions.question: A man invested Rs.96,000 at the rate of 20% per annum, compounded half-yearly for 1 year. What would be 80% of the amount (in Rs.) which he will get on maturity?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹96,000

Rate (R) = 20% per annum ⇒ 10% per half-year

Time = 1 year = 2 half-years

**Formula used:**

Amount A = P(1 + (r)/(100))^t

Required = 80% of A

**Calculations:**

A = 96000 × (1 + 10/100)² = 96000 × (1.1)² = 96000 × 1.21 = ₹116160

80% of ₹116160 = 116160 × 0.8 = ₹92928

**∴ 80% of the amount on maturity = ₹92,928**

questions.question: Two concentric circles are of radius 12 cm and r cm, respectively, where r > 12 cm. A chord of the larger circle of length 32 cm touches the smaller circle. Find the radius r?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Radius of smaller circle = 12 cm

Length of chord in larger circle = 32 cm

The chord touches the smaller circle ⇒ perpendicular distance from center to chord = 12 cm

**Formula used:**

Using right triangle: (half chord length)² + (distance from center)² = r²

**Calculations:**

Half of chord = 32 ÷ 2 = 16 cm

⇒ r² = 16² + 12² = 256 + 144 = 400

⇒ r = √400 = 20 cm

**∴ Radius of larger circle = 20 cm**

questions.question: Ramesh sold his bike for ₹16,384 and incurred a loss of 20%. At what price should he have sold the bike to gain a profit of 30%?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Selling Price at 20% loss = 80% of CP = ₹16,384

Required Selling Price at 30% profit = 130% of CP

New SP = (16384 ÷ 80) × 130

New SP = 204.8 × 130 = ₹26,624

**∴ The correct answer is ₹26,624.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Initial Selling Price (SP₁) = ₹16,384

Loss Percentage = 20%

Required Profit Percentage = 30%

**Formula Used:**

Cost Price (CP) = SP₁ × [100 ÷ (100 − Loss%)]

New Selling Price (SP₂) = CP × [(100 + Profit%) ÷ 100]

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3354fd4a48007f91c9082b8d64ad514fbc8afd0a625fb69d514f6d054af6a203.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ CP = 16384 × [100 ÷ (100 − 20)]

⇒ CP = 16384 × (100 ÷ 80)

⇒ CP = 204.8 × 100 = ₹20,480

⇒ SP₂ = 20480 × [(100 + 30) ÷ 100]

⇒ SP₂ = 20480 × (130 ÷ 100)

⇒ SP₂ = 2048 × 13 = ₹26,624

**∴ The correct answer is ₹26,624.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Cost Price (CP)

It is the exact price at which goods are originally bought. Profit and loss values are always calculated on the base cost price unless clearly specified otherwise.

Successive Percentage Change

When a value is updated successively by a% and b%, the total net percentage change is given by the formula: (a + b + ab ÷ 100)%.

Marked Price (MP) & Discount

Discount is fundamentally given on the marked price or printed price of the item. Consequently, Selling Price = MP − Discount.

questions.question:
If the solution of the pair of equations :

5x - 6y = 57 and 7x - 4y = 49 is also a solution of the equation 4x + my = 19, then what is the value of m?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Equations: 5x - 6y = 57 ....(1), 7x - 4y = 49 ....(2)

Also satisfies: 4x + my = 19

**Formula used:**

Solve (1) and (2) to get values of x and y

Substitute x and y in 4x + my = 19 to get m

**Calculations:**

Multiply (1) by 2: 10x - 12y = 114

Multiply (2) by 3: 21x - 12y = 147

⇒ Subtract: (21x - 12y) - (10x - 12y) = 147 - 114

⇒ 11x = 33 ⇒ x = 3

Substitute x = 3 in (1):

5 × 3 - 6y = 57 ⇒ 15 - 6y = 57 ⇒ -6y = 42 ⇒ y = -7

Substitute in 4x + my = 19:

4 × 3 + m × (-7) = 19 ⇒ 12 - 7m = 19

⇒ -7m = 7 ⇒ m = -1

**∴ Value of m = -1**

questions.question: Among 18 members of a cricket club, there are 2 wicketkeepers and 5 bowlers. In how many ways can a team of 11 players be selected to include only one of the wicketkeeper and atleast three bowlers?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Total members = 18

Wicketkeepers = 2

Bowlers = 5

Team size = 11 players

Condition: Select only 1 wicketkeeper and at least 3 bowlers

**Formula used:**

Ways = C(n, r)

**Calculations:**

Choose 1 wicketkeeper from 2: C(2,1) = 2

Remaining players to choose = 10

We will consider possible number of bowlers: 3 to 5

Case 1: 3 bowlers

→ C(5,3) = 10

Remaining 7 from non-wicketkeeper & non-bowlers = 18 - 2 - 5 = 11

→ C(11,7) = 330

Total = 2 × 10 × 330 = 6600

Case 2: 4 bowlers

→ C(5,4) = 5

Remaining 6 from 11 → C(11,6) = 462

Total = 2 × 5 × 462 = 4620

Case 3: 5 bowlers

→ C(5,5) = 1

Remaining 5 from 11 → C(11,5) = 462

Total = 2 × 1 × 462 = 924

Total ways = 6600 + 4620 + 924 = **12,144**

**∴ Required number of ways = 12,144**

questions.question: A can do a work in 8 days and B in 12 days. If they work together on it for 3 days, then the fraction of the work that is left is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total work = LCM of 8 and 12 = 24 units.

Combined efficiency of A and B = (24 ÷ 8) + (24 ÷ 12) = 3 + 2 = 5 units/day.

Work completed in 3 days = 5 × 3 = 15 units.

Work remaining = 24 − 15 = 9 units.

Fraction of work left = 9 ÷ 24 = 3/8.

**∴ The correct answer is 3/8.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Time taken by A to complete the work = 8 days

Time taken by B to complete the work = 12 days

Time they worked together = 3 days

**LCM Method:**

 
 

 **Person**
 **Days**
 **Total Work**
 **Efficiency**
 
 

 A
 8
 24

 B
 12
 2
 
 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total efficiency of A and B together = 3 + 2 = 5 units/day

⇒ Total work done by A and B in 3 days = Efficiency × Time = 5 × 3 = 15 units

⇒ Remaining work = Total work − Completed work = 24 − 15 = 9 units

⇒ Fraction of work left = Remaining work ÷ Total work = 9 ÷ 24 = 3/8

**∴ The correct answer is 3/8.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Work and Wages

Wages are distributed in proportion to the total work done by each person. If they work for the exact same duration, wages are directly proportional to their efficiencies.

Alternate Day Work

If two persons work on alternate days, find the total work done in a 2-day cycle and multiply it to get as close to the total work as possible, then add the remaining work for the next respective turn.

Pipes and Cisterns

This concept is identical to time and work, with the exception that an emptying pipe has a negative efficiency. Net efficiency = Sum of filling rates − Sum of emptying rates.

questions.question: In a room, there are some children and some benches. If 5 children sit on each bench, 2 children will have no bench to sit on. If 6 children sit on each bench, then one bench remains unoccupied. What is the sum of the number of children and the number of benches?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Let C = number of children

Let B = number of benches

**Calculation:**

Case 1: 5 children sit on each bench, 2 children have no bench.

C = 5B + 2 ------ (1)

Case 2: 6 children sit on each bench, 1 bench remains unoccupied.

Since one bench remains unoccupied, children sit on (B - 1) benches.

C = 6 × (B - 1)

C = 6B - 6 ------ (2)

Equating Equation 1 and Equation 2:

⇒ 5B + 2 = 6B - 6

⇒ 2 + 6 = 6B - 5B

⇒ B = 8

So, the number of benches (B) = 8

Substitute B = 8 into Equation 1 to find C:

C = 5 × 8 + 2

C = 40 + 2 = 42

So, the number of children (C) = 42

Sum of the number of children and the number of benches = C + B

= 42 + 8 = **50**

**The sum of the number of children and the number of benches is 50.**

questions.question: A person P purchases a washing machine for Rs.22,000 cash or for Rs.9,000 cash down payment and two monthly instalments of Rs.8,000 each. The rate of the simple interest is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Cash price of washing machine = ₹22,000

Cash down payment = ₹9,000

2 monthly instalments of ₹8,000 each

**Formula used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P times R times T)/(100)

**Calculations:**

Balance after down payment = 22000 - 9000 = ₹13,000

Total instalment amount = 8000 + 8000 = ₹16,000

Interest paid = 16000 - 13000 = ₹3,000

1st instalment paid after 1 month on ₹13,000

Remaining after 1st payment = 13000 - 8000 = ₹5,000

2nd instalment paid after 1 month on ₹5,000

Total principal for SI calculation = ₹13,000 for 1 month + ₹5,000 for 1 month = ₹18,000 for 1 month

Time (T) = 1 month = 1/12 years

⇒ 3000 = (18000 × R × 1/12) ÷ 100

⇒ 3000 = (18000 × R) ÷ 1200

⇒ 3000 × 1200 = 18000 × R

⇒ 3600000 = 18000 × R

⇒ R = 3600000 ÷ 18000 = 200

**∴ Rate of simple interest = 200% per annum**

questions.question: Find the value of 2 cosec² 23° cot² 67° - sin² 23° - sin² 67° - cot² 67°
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Convert 67° angles to 23° using cot 67° = tan 23° and sin 67° = cos 23°.

⇒ 2 cosec² 23° tan² 23° − (sin² 23° + cos² 23°) − tan² 23°

⇒ 2(1 / sin² 23°) × (sin² 23° / cos² 23°) − 1 − tan² 23°

⇒ 2 sec² 23° − 1 − tan² 23° = sec² 23° + (sec² 23° − tan² 23°) − 1

⇒ sec² 23° + 1 − 1 = sec² 23°

**∴ The correct answer is sec² 23°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

2 cosec² 23° cot² 67° − sin² 23° − sin² 67° − cot² 67°

**Formulas Used:**

sin(90° − θ) = cos θ

cot(90° − θ) = tan θ

sin² θ + cos² θ = 1

sec² θ − tan² θ = 1

**Calculation:**

⇒ 2 cosec² 23° cot²(90° − 23°) − sin² 23° − sin²(90° − 23°) − cot²(90° − 23°)

⇒ 2 cosec² 23° tan² 23° − sin² 23° − cos² 23° − tan² 23°

⇒ 2(1 / sin² 23°) × (sin² 23° / cos² 23°) − (sin² 23° + cos² 23°) − tan² 23°

⇒ 2(1 / cos² 23°) − 1 − tan² 23°

⇒ 2 sec² 23° − 1 − tan² 23°

⇒ sec² 23° + (sec² 23° − tan² 23°) − 1

⇒ sec² 23° + 1 − 1

⇒ sec² 23°

**∴ The correct answer is sec² 23°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Trigonometric Identities

The fundamental Pythagorean identities are sin² θ + cos² θ = 1, sec² θ − tan² θ = 1, and cosec² θ − cot² θ = 1.

Complementary Angles

Two angles are complementary if their sum is 90°. Key relations: sin(90° − θ) = cos θ, tan(90° − θ) = cot θ, and sec(90° − θ) = cosec θ.

Reciprocal Relations

Trigonometric ratios are related by reciprocal identities: cosec θ = 1 / sin θ, sec θ = 1 / cos θ, and cot θ = 1 / tan θ.

questions.question: If (y²-1)/(y)=6, then the value of (y⁶-1)/(y³) will be:
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

If y − 1/y = n, then y³ − 1/y³ = n³ + 3n.

From the given equation, (y² − 1) / y = 6 ⇒ y − 1/y = 6 (here n = 6).

Value = 6³ + 3 × 6

Value = 216 + 18 = 234

**∴ The correct answer is 234.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

⇒ (y² − 1) / y = 6

⇒ y − 1/y = 6

**To Find:**

⇒ (y⁶ − 1) / y³

⇒ y³ − 1/y³

**Formula Used:**

⇒ a³ − b³ = (a − b)³ + 3ab(a − b)

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let a = y and b = 1/y

⇒ y³ − 1/y³ = (y − 1/y)³ + 3 × y × (1/y) × (y − 1/y)

⇒ y³ − 1/y³ = (y − 1/y)³ + 3(y − 1/y)

⇒ Substitute the value of (y − 1/y) = 6 into the equation:

⇒ y³ − 1/y³ = 6³ + 3 × 6

⇒ y³ − 1/y³ = 216 + 18

⇒ y³ − 1/y³ = 234

**∴ The correct answer is 234.**

**__Additional Information__**

Algebraic Identities for Cubes

x³ + 1/x³ = (x + 1/x)³ − 3(x + 1/x)

Algebraic Identities for Squares

x² + 1/x² = (x + 1/x)² − 2 = (x − 1/x)² + 2

General Form of a³ + b³

a³ + b³ = (a + b)(a² − ab + b²) and a³ − b³ = (a − b)(a² + ab + b²)
</p

questions.question: Two trains start at the same time from stations P and Q, 1800 km apart, and proceed towards each other at an average speed of 108 km/h and 92km/h, respectively. The trains will meet at:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Since both trains start simultaneously, the distance covered is directly proportional to their speeds.

Ratio of speeds = 108 : 92 = 27 : 23

Total ratio parts = 27 + 23 = 50 parts

50 parts = 1800 km ⇒ 1 part = 36 km

Distance from station P = 27 × 36 = 972 km

**∴ The correct answer is 972 km from station P.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total distance between station P and Q = 1800 km

Speed of train from station P = 108 km/h

Speed of train from station Q = 92 km/h

**Formula Used:**

Relative Speed (in opposite directions) = S₁ + S₂

Time = Distance ÷ Relative Speed

Distance = Speed × Time

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a95f18b1c07b6561f6dc0224b287495c8d737f51d0f00b3a8911dcb1ea9998a.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Relative Speed = 108 + 92 = 200 km/h

⇒ Time taken to meet = 1800 ÷ 200 = 9 hours

⇒ Distance covered by the train from station P = 108 × 9 = 972 km

⇒ Distance covered by the train from station Q = 92 × 9 = 828 km

**∴ The correct answer is 972 km from station P.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Relative Speed in Opposite Directions

When two bodies move towards each other, their relative speed is calculated as the sum of their individual speeds (S₁ + S₂).

Proportionality of Distance and Speed

When the time of travel is constant (e.g. when objects start moving at the exact same time), the distance covered is directly proportional to their speeds. Hence, D₁ ÷ D₂ = S₁ ÷ S₂.

Relative Speed in Same Direction

When two bodies travel in the same direction, the relative speed is obtained by taking the difference of their individual speeds (S₁ − S₂).
</p

questions.question: In ∆ABC, ∠B = 90° and BD ⟂ AC. If AC = 9 cm and AD = 3 cm, then BD is equal to:
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

By the Geometric Mean Theorem for a right-angled triangle:

Altitude to hypotenuse = √(Product of hypotenuse segments)

CD = AC − AD = 9 − 3 = 6 cm

BD = √(3 × 6) = √18 = 3√2 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 3√2 cm.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

In right-angled ΔABC, ∠B = 90°

BD ⊥ AC

AC = 9 cm, AD = 3 cm

**Formula Used:**

In a right triangle, when an altitude is drawn from the right angle to the hypotenuse, the square of the altitude equals the product of the lengths of the two segments on the hypotenuse: BD² = AD × DC.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/daaaf049f5d8ba63677e68665bb1ea5f98a0bfb2e62df759bba5757e9ce0e137.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ DC = AC − AD

⇒ DC = 9 − 3 = 6 cm

⇒ BD² = AD × DC

⇒ BD² = 3 × 6

⇒ BD² = 18

⇒ BD = √18 = 3√2 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 3√2 cm.**

**__Additional Information__**

Geometric Mean Theorem (Altitude Rule)

In a right-angled triangle, the altitude drawn to the hypotenuse divides it into two segments such that the altitude is the geometric mean of these two segments. (Altitude² = Segment 1 × Segment 2)

Leg Rule of a Right Triangle

Each leg of a right-angled triangle is the geometric mean of the hypotenuse and the segment of the hypotenuse adjacent to that leg. (Leg² = Hypotenuse × Adjacent Segment)

Pythagorean Theorem

In a right-angled triangle, the square of the hypotenuse is equal to the sum of the squares of the other two legs. (H² = P² + B²)
</p

questions.question: A radii of the bases of the two cylinders are in the ratio 5 : 7 and their height are in the ratio 3 : 5. Find the ratio of their curved surface areas.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The Curved Surface Area (CSA) of a cylinder is proportional to the product of its radius and height.

⇒ Ratio of CSA = (r₁ × h₁) : (r₂ × h₂)

⇒ Ratio of CSA = (5 × 3) : (7 × 5)

⇒ Ratio of CSA = 15 : 35

⇒ Ratio of CSA = 3 : 7

**∴ The correct answer is 3 : 7.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dc36b5cf89c477255442ad458d594c2e64903cc5f691c91cd936807f0d8f3038.png] 

**Given:**

⇒ Let the radii of the two cylinders be r₁ = 5x and r₂ = 7x

⇒ Let the heights of the two cylinders be h₁ = 3y and h₂ = 5y

**Formula Used:**

⇒ Curved Surface Area of a cylinder = 2πrh

**Calculations:**

⇒ CSA of first cylinder (CSA₁) = 2 × π × (5x) × (3y) = 30πxy

⇒ CSA of second cylinder (CSA₂) = 2 × π × (7x) × (5y) = 70πxy

⇒ Ratio of their curved surface areas = CSA₁ : CSA₂

⇒ Ratio = 30πxy / 70πxy

⇒ Ratio = 30 / 70

⇒ Ratio = 3 / 7

**∴ The correct answer is 3 : 7.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Curved Surface Area (CSA)

It is the area of the curved part of the cylinder, excluding the flat circular bases. Formula: CSA = 2πrh

Total Surface Area (TSA)

It includes the curved surface area plus the area of the two circular bases (top and bottom). Formula: TSA = 2πr(r + h)

Volume of a Cylinder

The total space occupied inside the cylinder. Formula: V = πr²h
</p

questions.question: Ram, Shyam and Ghanshyam have ₹32, ₹46 and ₹50, respectively, with them. Their mother asks them to give her equal amounts so that the money held by them now are in continued proportion. Find the amount taken from each of them.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Ram has ₹32.

Shyam has ₹46.

Ghanshyam has ₹50.

They give equal amounts to their mother such that the remaining amounts are in continued proportion.

**Formula Used:**

For continued proportion: a/b = b/c or b² = a ⋅ c .

**Calculation:**

Let the amount given by each of them to their mother be x .

Then, the remaining amounts are:

Ram: ₹(32 - x)

Shyam: ₹(46 - x)

Ghanshyam: ₹(50 - x)

For continued proportion:

(32 - x)/(46 - x) = (46 - x)/(50 - x)

By cross-multiplication:

(46 - x)² = (32 - x) ⋅ (50 - x)

Expanding both sides:

⇒ (46 - x)² = 32 × 50 - 32x - 50x + x²

⇒ 2116 - 92x + x² = 1600 - 82x + x²

Cancel out x² from both sides:

⇒ 2116 - 92x = 1600 - 82x

Simplify:

⇒ 2116 - 1600 = 92x - 82x

⇒ 516 = 10x

⇒ x = 51.6

**The amount taken from each of them is ₹51.60.**

questions.question: If (3x + 4y)(5x - 6y) = ax² + 2hxy + by², then what is the value of (4a - h + 2b)?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Expand the binomials directly: (3x + 4y)(5x − 6y) = 15x² − 18xy + 20xy − 24y² = 15x² + 2xy − 24y²

Comparing with ax² + 2hxy + by², we can clearly deduce a = 15, h = 1, and b = −24.

Substitute these into the required expression: 4(15) − 1 + 2(−24) = 60 − 1 − 48 = 11.

**∴ The correct answer is 11.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

(3x + 4y)(5x − 6y) = ax² + 2hxy + by²

**Method Used:**

Polynomial expansion and comparison of coefficients of similar terms.

**Calculations:**

⇒ L.H.S = (3x + 4y)(5x − 6y)

⇒ L.H.S = 3x(5x − 6y) + 4y(5x − 6y)

⇒ L.H.S = 15x² − 18xy + 20xy − 24y²

⇒ L.H.S = 15x² + 2xy − 24y²

Comparing the simplified L.H.S with the R.H.S (ax² + 2hxy + by²):

⇒ Coefficient of x²: a = 15

⇒ Coefficient of xy: 2h = 2 ⇒ h = 1

⇒ Coefficient of y²: b = −24

Now, substitute the exact values of a, h, and b into the required expression (4a − h + 2b):

⇒ 4a − h + 2b = 4(15) − 1 + 2(−24)

⇒ 4a − h + 2b = 60 − 1 − 48

⇒ 4a − h + 2b = 59 − 48

⇒ 4a − h + 2b = 11

**∴ The correct answer is 11.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Algebraic Expansion

Multiplying two binomials strictly follows the distributive property where each term in the first parenthesis multiplies every term in the second: (a + b)(c + d) = ac + ad + bc + bd.

Equating Polynomials

Two polynomials are functionally identical if and only if the corresponding coefficients of variables with the exact same degree are strictly equal.

BODMAS Rule

For simplifying continuous values like 4(15) − 1 + 2(−24), multiplication is mandatorily performed prior to addition and subtraction matching the correct order of algebraic operations.
